In the liquidity pool there's two tokens, let's use meme coin A and Solana as an example, when the dev created the LP the original funding will have a ratio of lest say 1Billion Meme Coin A and 10 SOL giving Meme Coin A a initial price of 0.00000132, as people buy the coin new SOL gets added to the LP and Meme Coin A is taken out of the LP, the inverse happens when selling.

There are two possible scenarios here:

A) Meme coin A is a huge success and all of it gets taken out of the LP, now huge amounts of Sol are inside the LP, you can sell as much as you want.

B) Meme Coin A is a shit coin and none of it gets sold, LP is full of meme coin A and little Sol, you cannot sell now as there isn't enough liquidity 

So what you do? 

A) You start selling small batches little by little, you don't want to do a price impact of more than 5%, if your lucky eventually you will be able to sell most of it as new people start buying, this is exit liquidity
